label: violates
requirement: The advertised holiday price includes a hike accompanied by a guide.
meaning_constraints: Use varied counterexamples: self-guided maps only, guided hike separate charge, guided tour is bus not hike, optional extra not included, guide hire separate, no guided walking excursions.

clauses.text: For the elevated trail experience, the quoted price covers lodging and entry; the specialized trek requiring a local expert escort is billed separately.
clauses.rationale: Indicates the guide service is an additional, separate cost.

clauses.text: Kindly note that while our standard package includes mountain access, the supervised uphill walk requires pre-booking and an additional consultancy fee.
clauses.rationale: Specifies the guided hike aspect is optional or costs extra.

clauses.text: The advertised rate assumes self-navigation; any professionally led ascent or guided pathfinding must be arranged and paid for at the time of service.
clauses.rationale: Excludes guide service by emphasizing self-sufficiency.

clauses.text: Please review the itinerary: the scenic overlook access is included, but any facilitated ascent with an accompanying guide has an extra tariff.
clauses.rationale: Uses the term 'extra tariff' for the guide service.

clauses.text: While many itineraries feature trekking, remember that all structured, supervised uphill journeys are quoted outside of this base package rate.
clauses.rationale: Indicates the structure/guidance of the hike is separate from the base rate.

clauses.text: Bookings include passage to the trailhead point; remember that any guided trek exceeding the basic map reading capability incurs an additional charge.
clauses.rationale: Contrasts basic mapping with the need for a guide.

clauses.text: The package rate covers transport to the gorge; however, the specialized, led hiking portion must be purchased independently of the accommodation booking.
clauses.rationale: Treats the guide service as a purchasable, separate item.

clauses.text: This rate applies to self-paced exploration only. Any guided walking excursions are not part of the quoted sum.
clauses.rationale: Explicitly states that guided walking is not covered.

clauses.text: The cost displayed covers ground transportation and lodging; specialized, mentored hikes are supplementary services billed separately.
clauses.rationale: Uses 'supplementary services' to denote extra charges for the guide.

clauses.text: Reviewing the inclusions, the main trail pass is covered. Guidance for the summit climb is an optional add-on, payable on site.
clauses.rationale: Labels the guide service as an 'optional add-on'.

clauses.text: The rate covers basic ground access; any scheduled, professionally guided ascent is subject to a separate service fee.
clauses.rationale: Uses 'subject to a separate service fee' for the guide.

clauses.text: The total package price does not encompass private guide fees; those specialized treks are quoted at the point of confirmation.
clauses.rationale: Explicitly excludes guide fees from the total price.
